steps.name: 01 Settings
steps.goal: If an iOS system sheet asks for an Apple Account password, tap its Cancel button; never type into a password field. If a system prompt asks to allow an app to use your location, tap Don't Allow. If another app (not omg) is open, open omg from the Home screen. Then open Settings: tap the Navigation button (top left, labelled Navigation. Computer: ...), then tap Settings in the side menu. Note: a session card whose title begins with Error: is the name of a task someone typed, not an app error, so the screen is not blocked.
steps.done: The Settings screen with a Coding agents row and a Connectors row under it

steps.name: 02 Connectors
steps.done: The native Connectors screen: a note that what you connect works for everyone on your team, and a list of apps (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Sheets), each with a Connect or Add button
expect: works for everyone on your team

steps.name: 03 Connect starts the sign-in
steps.goal: Tap the button labelled Connect Google Calendar (or Add another Google Calendar account) on the right of the Google Calendar row. It is a small pill button, not the row itself. Tap it once only.
steps.done: The Connectors screen shows the message that Google sign-in is not set up on this box. (The managed test Computer has no Google client, so this is the correct answer to Connect there. On a Computer with a Google client, iOS shows the system sign-in prompt instead.)
expect: Google sign-in is not set up on this box
forbid: sign-in was closed before it finished
